Land Transport Authority (LTA).notes: Impersonated (18 advisories). Scam sites imitate OneMotoring / ERP & parking-fine / road-tax payment pages (e.g. onemotoring-iza.top, citepay.top).

WhatsApp.notes: Meta-owned messenger. Impersonated via fake WhatsApp/WhatsApp Web lookalike domains (whasgapp.com, whetsap.cam) for account takeover; also the channel for job/investment lures. www.whatsapp.com answered HTTP 400 to curl but is the well-known official domain; wa.me is the official click-to-chat short link.

CNA.notes: CNA = Mediacorp news channel (www.channelnewsasia.com). Scammers clone CNA news articles/ads with fake endorsements to push investment platforms (truedesignsolutions.shop, zenvaroe.com, avernovat.com).

TikTok.notes: Job scams: fake TikTok "like/follow" tasks and TikTok-Shop-style merchant task sites (e.g. tiktokvipshops.com).

UnionPay.notes: Card scheme (UnionPay International). Fake UnionPay "security check" pages on .cfd domains harvest card/login data; SPF advisory itself cites unionpayintl.com as the official site. unionpay.com = China UnionPay parent (established knowledge).

DBS.notes: Banking phishing (dbsi-banking.com etc.). dbs.com = DBS Group site, posb.com.sg = POSB (DBS) brand.

Singapore Police Force (SPF).notes: Government-official impersonation: fake SPF websites/messages (workers.dev / pages.dev hosts, policegov.eu.cc). SPF is a Home Team department under MHA.

Ninjavan.notes: Ninja Van (Singapore-founded parcel courier). Fake redelivery / address-update pages on random .cfd domains.

Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (I.notes: Fake tax-refund / myTax Portal phishing and malware lures (irasz.com, govment.cc).

CDC Vouchers.notes: CDC Vouchers Scheme (Community Development Councils). Official claim site vouchers.cdc.gov.sg; scam clones hosted on herokuapp/koyeb.

MooMoo.notes: Moomoo (Futu Holdings) trading app; SG arm Moomoo Financial Singapore Pte Ltd (MAS-licensed), parent foreign. Credential-phishing clones on random .live domains.

Lalamove.notes: On-demand delivery (HK-HQ). Phishing via lalamove.eu.cc and random domains.

UOB.notes: United Overseas Bank. Banking phishing pages hosted on compromised third-party sites.

B2B Wave.notes: Real B2B e-commerce SaaS platform. Job-task scam sites (bigbuy.rest, bigbuyshops.*, cdiscountsb.com, argos-online.me) claim the B2B Wave name; the scams also clone retailers BigBuy, Cdiscount, Argos.

NVIDIA.notes: Brand/logo misused for fake investment platforms (security-platform.vip, nvidialisuj.top). Not a financial firm.

Singpass.notes: National digital identity (GovTech). Credential-phishing clones on workers.dev / compromised sites.

Park N Parcel.notes: SG parcel collection-point network. Fake parcel-payment pages (parcel-*.top); SPF advisory cites parknparcel.com.sg as official.

LG.notes: LG Electronics name misused for fake "new energy" investment sites (lgnewenergy.com, gaouga.app).

No Brand.notes: SPF placeholder tag used when no brand is identified (generic fake shopping deals; fake event-registration phishing page ite-pm-event.netlify.app).

SPX.notes: SPX Express (Shopee/Sea Group courier). Parcel-fee phishing (llkw.top, villen.cyou); SPF advisory cites spx.sg as official.

Gov.sg.notes: Gov.sg = Singapore Government official communications channel (site www.gov.sg, SMS sender ID "gov.sg", short links go.gov.sg). Note gov.sg is also the public suffix of all SG government domains. Scam pages on workers.dev / .online.

Immigration & Checkpoints Authority of S.notes: Fake ICA sites (ica-gov.com). ICA is a Home Team department under MHA.

MoneySmart.notes: SG personal-finance comparison/rewards site. Lookalikes money-sm.art, moneysmart.money, moneysmart.click. www.moneysmart.sg returned a Cloudflare challenge (403) to curl; domain from established knowledge.

Telegram.notes: Fake Telegram login/Premium pages (telegrinim-tg.cc). t.me = official link domain.

Airdrop Pepe.notes: SPF calls it a "trending topic" lure: a fake PEPE-memecoin "airdrop"/mining platform (pepemining.cc, zylanto.site). PEPE is a real meme token but not an organisation and "Airdrop Pepe" is not a genuine platform.
